newsitem.title: USA: Moldova buys 13,309 T U.S. PL 480 long grain rice.
newsitem.headline: Moldova buys 13,309 T U.S. PL 480 long grain rice.

text.p: Moldova bought on Thursday 13,309 tonnes U.S. No. 2 long grain milled rice under the PL 480 export program, the U.S. Department of Agriculture said.

The purchase was divided into three lots. One lot of 2,600 tonnes was acquired from Louis Dreyfus at $406.28 a tonne, free alongside (FAS), U.S. Gulf. Another of 1,500 tonnes was from Garnac Grain at $405.65 and a third lot of 9,209.50 tonnes was acquired from Continental Grain at $408.84.
Shipment period is set for November 1-25.
